**PR #893 (promotion sitting #892) APPROVE at abf54a7a — ADR-0034, ADR-0002 A2, consolidation §5 and README rule 3 ready for the maintainer's merge**

**What**: PR #893 (Closes #892, type:chore + decision) carries the maintainer's three promotes (41286507 ADR-0034, 83076d51 ADR-0002 Amendment 2, 34f3640d consolidation-protocol §5), the README rule 3 patch (6d5785b1) and two agent corrections after review (f434a911, abf54a7a). Cold review: round 1 APPROVE with four citation corrections, round 2 APPROVE with only tier2-frontier (expected on a promotion). Ready for the maintainer's merge on 2026-09-09.

**Why**: closes the #862 ruling's Tier 2 half; after merge, tasks 5.1–5.3 of issue-862-memory-lane can be ticked and the change archived.

**Where**: brain/project/decisions/adr-0034-memory-travels-on-its-own-lane.md, adr-0002-*.md, brain/core/methodology/consolidation-protocol.md, brain/HOME.md, AGENTS.md, openspec/README.md; the draft copy under openspec/changes/issue-862-memory-lane/brain-drafts/ was kept in sync with the promoted ADR.

**Learned**: `brain:nav` (CI job `n`) refuses any `brain/...` path cited between backticks that does not exist yet — ADRs must name future directories in prose ("a new memory/lane/ directory under brain/scripts/ (#887 creates it)"). Citations without the `brain/` prefix escape that regex, so the cold reviewer is the only net for them. An ADR must not state in present tense what a future slice will build (the gates "learn" the lane in 3.1c).
